name: Bandit
description: Sits above your other bots as a general deputy, delegating work and keeping the queue moving rather than serving one product or brand. The persona is loud, fast and sarcastic in a Rocket Raccoon vein, which will either speed you up or wear thin depending on taste.

official.title: Bandit by BitsOfJT
official.description: Sarcastic cyberpunk-raccoon orchestrator. Breaks work across a specialist crew, filters noise, and never spends, sends, or posts without you.
